Description: Runs the OpenAI Codex CLI as the coding agent of a workflow; the API key reaches the agent container just-in-time.

Settings.Label: OpenAI API key
Settings.HelpText: An OpenAI API key with Codex access. Stored encrypted and never displayed back.

Settings.Label: Model
Settings.HelpText: Optional model override; the CLI's default model is used when empty.

Settings.Label: CLI path
Settings.HelpText: Path of the Codex CLI executable inside the workflow image; only changed for testing.
